title: Hada Labo Gokujyun Hyaluronic Lotion 400ml
description_en: Japan's #1 bestselling face lotion for over a decade. Packed with 5 types of hyaluronic acid that hold 6,000× their weight in moisture. Fragrance-free, colorant-free, mineral oil-free. Dermatologist approved.
description_ja: 10年以上連続売上No.1の化粧水。5種のヒアルロン酸が水分を抱え込みもちもち肌へ。無香料・無着色・無鉱物油。皮膚科医推薦。
